QUOTE: If the server error is `DELETED_ROOT_POST_ERROR`, `TOWN_SQUARE_READ_ONLY_ERROR` or `PLUGIN_DISMISSED_POST_ERROR`, the post is removed (line 181).
VERDICT: HIT
